query:
insert into ManuallyVerifiedRequirements (
                    latest_collection,
                    product_id,
                    review_name,
                    req_id,
                    comment_hash
                )
                values(
                    $1,
                    $2,
                    $3,
                    $4,
                    $5
                )
                on conflict (
                    product_id,
                    review_name,
                    req_id
                ) do update
                set
                    latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                    comment_hash = excluded.comment_hash
